tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have in his/Firm name executed one similar nature of assignment of value not less than 50% of the tender.i.e Rupees 11.50 lakhs. The Tenderer should furnish copy of the satisfactory execution of the assignment/Contract from the Employers. Experience Certificate issued by the head of the Department indicating provided Man Power services to the Government/ Semi Government Departments in for the year 2023-2024, 2024-25, 2025-26 (consider only the work done certificate not the work order)
Professional Tax Registration Certificate for the year 2025-2026
Copy of Form C Registration Certificate from labour department.(The Firm should enclose current year valid Certificate.) & Labour Clearence certificate After January-2026 Year
Enclose Valid Pan card & GST registration certificate Copy

Enclose a copy of GST Registration Certificate of agency/organization and for the year 2025-2026 list of Service providing to Different government department or non- government departments/office with values. Further enclose a copy of monthly GST returns and schedules of TDS deducted from different departments/ offices along with GST paid Challans matched against those TDS deducted by different departments/ offices

The Tenderer should have achieved in his/Firm name a minimum financial turnover of value not less than tender.i.e Rupees 23.00 lakhs in any three financial years in between 2021-22 TO 2025-26. The Tenderer should furnish the copies of the audited certificates
